|notes=* Decipher [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998) revised game text. Printed face: [[Captain Piett]]. Side-by-side faces: [[Errata]].
* The image is Decipher's own entry, cut unchanged from page 32 of the Glossary; Decipher published this errata as text only. The Glossary prints a ruling under the entry (“This Imperial may take a Probe Droid into hand any number of times during any player’s turn.”), which is not game text and is not in the crop.
* Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered [[Captain Piett (Revised)]], October 1998, before the Glossary: read word for word off the card, with “''Executor''” in italics where the Glossary prints it upright, and no ruling sentence. That white-bordered card is its own version, so it is not the card shown here.
* The card shown under it is black-bordered, like the original card the errata applies to: the Players Committee's D-E1 card of 23 December 2022, [[Captain Piett (PC 2022 D-E1 card)]], with Decipher's words.

Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered reprint, [[Captain Piett (Revised)]].
